Explore hit order

Carry target HP and shield through a sequence. Move hits, pin an order, and inspect exactly where the outcomes diverge.

Choose an explicit scope in the input: no effects between hits, or only the controlled Old Embers interaction. Old Embers assumes an ordinary visible monster, one unbanned state, no HP-loss immunity or limits, and no other reactive effects. Cards, resources, automatic pursuits, other state triggers, hit limits and death resistance are not simulated. Inputs describe already resolved hits, not legal card actions. Results are not gameplay verified.
